head: Warned or not, a small open model saw the link to the 2025 price and answered without opening it
sub: Do warned open-weight agents still follow a hidden canary link? Answer: Not settled, because gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-8B, the two models the question names, have not run yet. A small side model, {model}, almost never opened any link: {qwen3_17b_neutral_cued_k} of {qwen3_17b_neutral_cued_n} runs unwarned, {qwen3_17b_warning_cued_k} of {qwen3_17b_warning_cued_n} warned, {qwen3_17b_vis_k} of {qwen3_17b_vis_n} with the link shown. So it cannot show what a warning does.
start: {model} starts on the home page. The 2025 price is only behind the footer link. On the trap page people cannot see it, so a visit in our server log flags an AI agent.
